name: Tocaima (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of grey and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tocaima (a black eagle on yellow within a ring inscribed HIDALGA Y NOBLE CIUDAD SALUD DE COLOMBIA).
history: Municipal flag of Tocaima, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Tocaima arms — black eagle on yellow within an inscribed ring
